channel.title: Blockchain Today
channel.description: Blockchain Today reports crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and network upgrades, with analysis of what changed.

item.title: US secures court authority over $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department says court orders cover more than $1.2 billion of Binance hack proceeds, part of $2.7 billion frozen so far as recovery and forfeiture continue.

item.title: US secures authority over $1.2 billion in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department says a court authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion, part of $2.7 billion frozen after Binance’s October theft.

item.title: US targets $1.2 billion of crypto stolen from Binance
item.description: The Justice Department says court orders cover more than $1.2 billion of Binance hack proceeds, within $2.7 billion frozen so far, as tracing continues.

item.title: US Wins Court Authority Over $1.2B in Binance Stolen Crypto
item.description: The DOJ says courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion of Binance’s stolen crypto, part of a wider freeze that still faces forfeiture proceedings.

item.title: Zcash vote weighs 50,000 ZEC grants-treasury removal
item.description: Zcash’s Nov. 16–30 polls will weigh a draft to remove 50,000 ZEC from grants and redirect future funding, shifting support toward miners and a locked fund.

item.title: Visa adds Monad to its stablecoin settlement network
item.description: Visa added Monad as a stablecoin settlement option for participating issuers and acquirers, widening its network menu as institutional privacy tools remain in development.

item.title: Schwab adds Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink trading
item.description: Charles Schwab added SOL, AVAX and LINK to Schwab Crypto, lifting its direct-trading lineup to five assets while retaining a 0.75% trade fee and eligibility limits.

item.title: Ethereum puts Glamsterdam on hold over gas-accounting risks
item.description: Ethereum has paused Glamsterdam’s Hoodi rollout while developers review eight gas assumptions affected by EIP-8037 and EIP-8038; no new date is set.

item.title: Zcash NU7 cuts target block time to 25 seconds
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, cutting target blocks to 25 seconds while limiting shielded activity and redirecting most transaction fees to a reserve.

item.title: Treasury orders U.S. transfer cutoff for MEXC
item.description: FinCEN's order will bar U.S. institutions from transfers to or from MEXC after Federal Register publication, testing the reach of a Russia-focused tool as it takes effect.

item.title: FBI ties record Binance theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor
item.description: The FBI tied Binance’s October 29 theft of more than $6 billion to North Korea’s TraderTraitor, putting fund tracing and customer reimbursement in focus.

item.title: FBI links Binance’s $6.3bn theft to North Korea
item.description: FBI attributes Binance’s $6.3 billion theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor group, urging crypto services to block addresses as funds move into Ether.

item.title: Zcash activates NU7, cutting target block time to 25 seconds
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, cutting target blocks to 25 seconds while capping shielded activity and reserving fees for future mining rewards.

item.title: What SunSwap Lets You Reuse Between Trades
item.description: A token approval may carry over, but each SunSwap trade needs a fresh quote and wallet confirmation; learn what stays in place and what to check again.

item.title: Binance’s $6.3B theft exposes the cost of hot-wallet access
item.description: Binance says attackers drained about $6.34 billion through hot-wallet signing access; it has replenished 98% while tracing frozen assets and reopening withdrawals.

item.title: Fraxswap on Fraxtal: Why Its Pools Keep Separate Liquidity
item.description: Fraxswap on Fraxtal uses its own token-pair pools, so prices, depth and execution depend on liquidity on that network rather than Ethereum balances.

item.title: South Korea proposes fourth delay to crypto tax, until 2029
item.description: South Korea will ask lawmakers to move crypto income tax from 2027 to 2029, citing delayed US data sharing and unfinished rules as a fourth postponement looms.

item.title: NEAR holders back a gradual cut to 1.6% issuance
item.description: NEAR’s House of Stake approved a two-year issuance cut, but the 2.5% ceiling remains until council review, a grace period and validator adoption are complete.

item.title: Binance expands withdrawals after $6.3bn hot-wallet breach
item.description: Binance began a phased reopening of withdrawals after a $6.3bn hot-wallet breach; trading continued, while security checks still govern access to funds.

item.title: FBI links record $6bn Binance theft to North Korea
item.description: The FBI tied Binance’s record theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor, as stolen assets move into Ethereum and crypto services face pressure to block laundering.
